adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts, the code at lines 68-78 shows that when updating an existing credential, only the 'key' field is updated via prisma.credential.update(). The Credential model likely has an 'invalid' field (common pattern for OAuth credentials that have been revoked/expired). When syncing new valid credentials, if the credential was previously marked as invalid=true, this update would leave that flag unchanged, meaning the integration would still appear broken to the user despite having valid credentials. This is a real bug - the update should also set invalid=false to restore the integration.
